description: Installations « Biogaz » (2020 - France métropolitaine) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Installations producing and/or operating biogas (or likely to). This dataset reuses data (2020 anniversary) from ADEME’s SINOE platform. It provides precise geolocation of the following facilities: ISDND, Non-hazardous waste storage facilities; Methanisation; TMB/Mechanical-Biological Treatment for Project Facilities; Biological treatment; Physico-chemical treatment. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "“Biogaz” installations (2020 — Metropolitan France)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include méthanisation, biogaz, traitement. The listing shows 2021-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
